mutants.equivalent: a stacked gap stacks its label slots at least slotHeight apart (edgeLines*15+11) and every label is at most edgeLines*15+6 tall, so a label sliding sideways in its own slot keeps more than LABEL_CLEARANCE from every other label, node and note; the check is kept as a guard should the slots change (confirmed by the independent review)
